title: Candice Lifecycle Event
description: Versioned lifecycle control envelope shared by the MCP process, the local bridge, the companion app, the fallback path, and startup recovery. One discriminated branch per lifecycle event: activation, question, delivered (acknowledgement), answer, cancel, fallback, reconnect, lease, and lifecycle state. Every durable operation carries operationId plus bounded timestamps; temporal bounds (max age, future skew, lease horizon) are enforced by the runtime validator plugins/candice-integration/session/lifecycle-protocol.js, which this schema documents and mirrors. The governed question text and answer text never enter this envelope: they ride the FIX-011 bridge frames and the question-event/answer-event schemas, and are never persisted by the lifecycle layer. Candice Master Spec sections 13.2/14/16/17/20. Version: 1.0. Bumped by the integration/release owner only (manifest 9.4 class 2); consumers reject unknown versions.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this lifecycle envelope. Consumers reject unknown versions; producers must not silently downgrade.

event.description: Authenticated activation of one session binding (FIX-010 identity consumed, never replaced).

sessionId.description: Opaque Claude Code session identifier. Routing authority; never derived from window position.

activationId.description: Single-use activation claim id issued with the session binding.

activationIssuedAt.description: ISO-8601 issuance time. Bounded: not older than the max-age window, not ahead of the future-skew window.

event.description: Lifecycle record of one governed question operation being delivered. The governed text itself rides the question-event schema; this branch is identity and timing only.

operationId.description: Stable operation identity for this one question transition; a retry of the same operation id is idempotent, a different id for the same question is refused.

questionKey.description: Governed question key owned by FIX-012; the lifecycle layer stores and routes only validated governed keys.

event.description: The companion acknowledged the exact question surface; only an acknowledged delivery may transition to displayed.
One terminal answer completion for the operation. This branch is bookkeeping only (identity, key, time): answer text rides the answer-event schema and is never persisted by the lifecycle layer.
The question surface was cancelled/invalidated by the matching (sessionId, questionKey, operationId); a later answer for the same operation must fail closed.
Ownership of this question atomically transferred to the Claude terminal fallback; the original validated question, session, key, and counted flag are preserved.

cause.description: Machine-readable fallback cause; all fallback branches invoke the same coordinator method with the same validated question.

event.description: The same authenticated session reconnected; mismatched or replayed identities are refused before this event exists.

operationId.description: The single unacknowledged pending operation being resumed, or a fresh operation id when nothing was pending.

event.description: Recovery lease claim on one pending operation. A lease never deletes the pending record; only an acknowledged handoff may complete it. Bounded by heldUntil.

leaseId.description: Opaque lease id; a second process claiming the same operation must arrive with the same or refused lease.

heldUntil.description: ISO-8601 lease horizon (bounded: within max lease length, not past the future-skew window).

event.description: Published lifecycle state for one session: durable states plus live connection states. Transition order is owned by the single lifecycle owner, never by an event.

operationId.description: Present when the state is scoped to one operation; absent for session-scoped states.
